scope: close review gap: protection is now a defense-interaction outcome and can be passed/ignored
close review gap: first-class attachment pp:'clear' consumes the source slot's remaining PP

reviewVerdict.burn: not a hard gap: model.js applies modifier('burn-modifier', 0.5) only under the Gen3 burn condition; returning 1 cancels the halving. The branch gates whether the modifier runs, not whether it is effective.
reviewVerdict.protection: was a real gap: native protected returned false after defense-interaction, so scaledDamage never applied and there was no public pass. Closed by making protected the default defense outcome.
reviewVerdict.pp: was a partial gap: no pp field and no augment+attachment mixing; pp-cost could force 0 only for non-self targets. Closed with pp:'clear'.
